planSteps.description: Navigate to the local home page at /.
Wait up to 10 seconds for the page's available-times request to finish before inspecting the date and time controls.
Verify the page identifies the Nike Sawgrass outlet and shows a date selector with hourly appointment slots.
Choose a valid date in the available booking range and select an available slot.
Verify the selected slot is visibly selected and any unavailable or booked slots remain visible but disabled.
Complete the customer details form with clearly fake local test data, but stop before any real or live payment is submitted.
Verify the booking flow accepts the form and presents the Test Mode booking-payment step or an equivalent pending-payment state.
